preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100,000.
For each test case, n, a, and b must be positive integers not exceeding 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output for each test case must be either 'Yes' or 'No'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Yes' if n in set else stdout == 'No'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'Yes' if n is in the generated set, otherwise 'No'.
